question: to the Commission Catarina Martins (The Left) Subject:

The Portuguese Parliament has started the process to repeal Law No 38/2018, which establishes the right to self-determination of gender identity and gender expression. If passed, the self-determination, depathologised model of gender recognition will be put to an end and access to specific healthcare will be denied. The measures run counter to the EU’s LGBTIQ+ equality strategy, breach the right to respect for private and family life laid down in the Charter of Fundamental Rights of the European Union and go against case-law that bans discrimination based on gender reassignment, as well as international scientific recommendations accepted by the WHO. In light of the above: 1.

Does the Commission believe that the legislation, the general terms of which have been approved in Portugal, is consistent with the Charter of Fundamental Rights of the European Union, particularly Articles 1, 7 and 21, and the Court of Justice of the European Union’s case-law regarding discrimination based on gender identity?
Does the Commission intend to examine whether these measures are in line with the LGBTIQ+ equality strategy 2026-2030 and the Member States’ equality of treatment obligations?
answer: EN on behalf of the European Commission (15.6.2026) The Commission does not comment on draft legislation or ongoing national legislative processes. Equality and non-discrimination are founding values of the EU enshrined in the Treaty on the EU and the Charter of Fundamental Rights of the EU. The Commission remains firmly committed to combating discrimination and inequalities faced by LGBTIQ+1 people, also via the LGBTIQ+ equality strategy 2026-20302, which builds on the progress achieved under the 2020-2025 strategy. The Commission will continue to closely monitor the situation of LGBTIQ+ people across the EU, within the limits of its competences, and to use all the instruments at its disposal to uphold EU law in Member States.
1 Lesbian, gay, bisexual, trans, non-binary, intersex and queer. 2 https://commission.europa.eu/document/download/b4952371-4308-47ad-b995-
